name: A9 Pro Airpods ANC/ENC Noise Reduction, Touch Control With LED Display White TWS
description:
Model: A9 Pro
Noise Cancelling: Active Noise Cancellation (ANC), Environmental Noise Cancellation (ENC)
Bluetooth Standard: Bluetooth v5.3
Battery Indicator: LED
Chipset: JL
Material: ABS
Waterproof Standard: IPX-4
Wireless delay time: 30 Ms
Place of Origin: Guangdong
Private Mold: Yes
Battery Capacity(mAh): 500MAH
Play/next song: Song play/pause/can be controlled through the color screen. Previous song/next song.
Volume "+" "-": Can control the volume of the mobile phone system through the color screen. Add or subtract.
Noise reduction/permeability/closure: ANC noise reduction function can be controlled through the color screen. Switch with permeability.
Equalizer: Five tone colors can be controlled through the color screen. Package includes/contains standard mode, popular mode, Jazz mode, rock mode, and classic mode.
6″ inch full touch display
3 type sound mode 1 regular 2 ANC 3 Transparent
5 diffrent welcome themes
Sound wave editing feature
Superb sound quality
Suitable for all mobiles
Real time power indicator
Fully touch display
Bestest features earbuds ever
If have any manufacturing defect then 7 days replacement Gurranty (If products have found any spot or damage then not returnable)
